name: VMS TMT LIMITED
summary: VMS TMT Limited manufactures and sells thermo-mechanically treated high-strength reinforcement steel bars in India. The company offers TMT bars under the Kamdhenu NXT brand name; and sells billets and binding wires, scrap, and mill scale. It serves individual house builders, contractors, governmental authorities, and industrial customers in a range of industries, including roadways, engineering services, retailers, and real estate. VMS TMT Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
